description: Audit the sitemap URLs page by page (cvrt-seo-manager 1.18.0+, feature page_audit; refused with a clear message on an older plugin): returns { pages: [{ url, status, h1_count, missing_alt, og_image, findings }], truncated, next_offset, ... }. A call audits `limit` URLs from `offset` within a time budget; while truncated is true, continue with offset = next_offset.

limit.description: URLs to audit in this call (1-100, default 20)

offset.description: Index of the first URL to audit (default 0; use next_offset to continue)

name: seo_audit_pages
